note:
One override, for debt. CarMart's total debt read as SeniorNotes alone ($263,681 thousand at FY2026) because that is the only debt concept the shared vocabulary's gap-fill reaches for this filer -- but SeniorNotes is only one of three lines it carries, and the concept vocabulary itself is not the place to fix this: us-gaap:SeniorNotes is already an ANALYZE-side gap-fill for VeriSign, and roughly 40 other SeniorNotes filers (mostly REITs -- SL Green, Digital Realty, Welltower, Host Hotels) already carry data under the debt component tags this filer also uses, so widening either role in the shared vocabulary risked changing their totals along with CarMart's. This binding reads the same rendered balance sheet lines but keeps the fix scoped to this one filer.

The filer's debt has two eras. Through FY2025 the notes-payable line was tagged us-gaap:NotesPayable alone and there was no senior/secured split. Starting with the FY2026 10-K it prints two lines instead of one -- 'Senior Secured Notes Payable, net' (a new us-gaap:SeniorNotes) and 'Non-recourse notes payable, net' (the old line, retagged us-gaap:OtherNotesPayable) -- so FY2026 total debt is the sum of both, not SeniorNotes alone: $263,681 + $458,685 = $722,366 thousand, not $263,681 thousand. The revolving line of credit is a third, separate line the shared vocabulary does not reach at all for this filer; it also switched tags, from us-gaap:LineOfCredit (through the FY2023 10-K) to the extension crmt:LongTermLineOfCreditNetOfDebtIssuanceCosts (from the FY2024 10-K).

Scoped to FY2022 onward, where us-gaap:NotesPayable data is clean and continuous in companyfacts; FY2021 and earlier show 0 or near-zero under every debt concept this filer has ever tagged, which reads as the company having genuinely little debt on the balance sheet those years rather than a tagging gap, and is left alone.

metrics.label: Non-recourse notes payable, net
metrics.note: One line, two tag names across the FY2026 restructuring. $458,685 thousand at FY2026, $572,010 thousand at FY2025.

metrics.label: Senior Secured Notes Payable, net
metrics.note: New line, split out of the notes-payable balance starting FY2026. $263,681 thousand at FY2026.

metrics.label: Revolving line of credit, net
metrics.note: Zero at FY2026 -- the facility is undrawn, not absent. $204,769 thousand at FY2025.

metrics.label: Long-Term Debt
metrics.note: Summed, because CarMart tags no consolidated total: these three lines are the whole of it. zero_if_absent because the senior-secured split does not exist before FY2026 and the revolver reads zero some years -- either being absent from the sum would understate a year that is otherwise fully covered.
